name: pricing-comparison
title: Pricing comparison table
description: Grouped feature comparison table with a sticky plan header, and per-plan tabs on mobile.

standards.purpose: State what each plan costs and includes so a visitor can choose without contacting sales.
useWhen: The product has priced tiers to compare.
doNotUseWhen: Prices are not final — never publish placeholder pricing.

rules.check: Two to four tiers; more requires a comparison table rather than plan cards.
At most one tier is featured as recommended.
Every price states its currency and billing interval, and an interval switch updates all prices.
